protocol.feature: Home capped rest days minus away capped rest days before the match.
protocol.same_date_rule: All matches on a date are predicted before that date updates team history.
protocol.history_reset: Rest history and Elo reset at each dataset season.

decision.rule: Retain only if training selects a nonzero coefficient and holdout improvement has an interval fully below zero.
decision.result: Rejected: rest-day difference did not pass the WSL holdout gate.

limitations: Calendar-day rest does not measure player minutes, travel, sleep, training load, or squad rotation.
The cap limits long breaks but is a prespecified modeling choice rather than an estimated fatigue threshold.
Only league fixtures contained in each StatsBomb season dataset contribute to rest history.
One WSL holdout does not establish workload effects for current UEFA men's clubs.
